title: 노란 하트
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with synth-pop elements. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated eighth notes with light chorus and delay. A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the chord progression. Percussion consists of a dry, electronic kick on beats 1 and 3, with a crisp clap on beats 2 and 4. Soft, airy female vocals occupy the center of the mix with moderate plate reverb. A bright, polyphonic synth pad enters during transitions. Key of E Major, 85 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[arpeggiated clean electric guitar, soft synth pad]

[Verse 1]
[airy female vocals]
잊으려 애를 써봐도
정리하려고 열었어
을지로 골뱅이 집 이름
만 오천 원 3월 14일
노란 하트 이모지
그날 눈이 왔었지
셋이서 웃던 사진이 있어
꼬박 24분 동안
스크롤 스르르 내려
금액은 [synth swell]
